### The One, True God
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/the-one-true-god-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-january-5-2015.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 4:39
Points:
- Modern culture rarely bows to carved idols, yet people still make gods out of money, status, relationships, and appearances.
- Placing ultimate trust in worldly securities inevitably leads to disappointment when circumstances change or crises hit.
- Whatever replaces the living God in a person's life functions as an idol that cannot save them.
- Just as God exposed Egypt's worthless gods through the plagues, He exposes the emptiness of our modern substitutes.
- The Lord alone is the sovereign, living God of heaven and earth, and only He will prevail and deliver.
